purpose: Decompose causal effects of randomized training exposure by the relation between the exposed training payload and the evaluated task.

relations.meaning: The evaluation task is the same source item and target instance that appeared in the treatment exposure payload.
relations.include: Exact task identity and target are established from sealed source lineage.
relations.exclude: Same template with changed parameters; surface or semantic variants.
relations.interpretation: Narrow exact-instance retention; not by itself proof of rote memorization.

relations.meaning: The same underlying item and target are expressed with transformed wording, formatting, tokenization, or presentation.
relations.include: Transformation is judged to preserve the item, required reasoning and target.
relations.exclude: A new target, altered assumptions, or an equivalent task requiring a different skill.

relations.meaning: An independently authored reformulation with the same underlying problem, assumptions, solution target and required reasoning.
relations.include: Blinded experts independently accept semantic and answer equivalence.
relations.exclude: Shared domain alone, same topic, approximate similarity or ambiguous task mapping.
relations.interpretation: Semantic retention beyond lexical overlap; still related to the exposed target.

relations.meaning: A fresh instance generated after checkpoint freeze with new parameters/data, using the same solution recipe as exposed training.
relations.include: Generator seed and hidden parameters are post-freeze; recipe lineage is evaluator-verified.
relations.exclude: Exact replay, same target, or a different recipe.
relations.interpretation: Instance transfer within a learned task recipe.

relations.meaning: A different task recipe requiring the same predeclared skill/capability, with no shared solution recipe or target instance.
relations.include: A skill ontology and blinded experts support same-skill/different-recipe mapping.
relations.exclude: Same recipe with changed numbers; merely same topic or broad domain.
relations.interpretation: Cross-recipe transfer of the target skill; strongest evidence here for generalizable competence.

relations.meaning: A task matched on format and externally calibrated difficulty but requiring a different target construct or skill.
relations.include: No source/recipe/target lineage overlap with the exposure payload.
relations.exclude: A task sharing the target skill or recipe.
relations.interpretation: Negative control for generic training drift and unintended score shifts.

domains.coverage: algebra, arithmetic, proof-relevant and quantitative reasoning
program synthesis, debugging, API use and algorithmic reasoning
mechanistic explanation, quantitative science and evidence interpretation
closed-book factual recall with time-scoped source provenance
multi-step tool/environment tasks with evaluator-controlled state
image/audio/video-grounded tasks with content-addressed evaluator inputs

design_rules: Reuse the existing randomized source-cluster assignment, matched-token placebo and paired training receipt; do not re-randomize at item level.
Evaluate base, treatment and placebo checkpoints on the exact same item IDs and scoring oracle in every relation/family/difficulty cell.
Every task family and difficulty band must contain all six relation strata with matched item and cluster counts.
Each model-pair replicate must use the same item-set, source-lineage, recipe-lineage and adjudication commitments for every matched cell.
Use externally calibrated easy/medium/hard bands where feasible; do not define difficulty from post-treatment model scores.
Keep semantic-equivalence and same-skill judgments blinded; disputes and indeterminate judgments do not enter positive strata.
Use a deterministic primary scoring policy; treat stochastic decoding repeats as nested measurements, not extra training replicates.
Keep relation labels, hidden item IDs, source/recipe lineage and answer oracles outside model-visible payloads.

Each relation × task-family × difficulty cell requires at least three distinct blinded adjudicator pseudonyms and an Accepted decision; Indeterminate and Rejected cells cannot be included in scored relation strata.
The minimum item-level adjudication agreement is at least 800‰ for all relations; semantic_equivalent and novel_recipe_same_skill require unanimous 1000‰ item-level agreement.
Reviewer identities and the full adjudication report digest are bound across independent model-pair replicates; these content commitments are not authenticated identity proof.

estimands.unit: percentage points; uncertainty across independent model-pair training replicates

metrics: Base/treatment/placebo accuracy and denominators by relation × task family × difficulty band.
95% Student-t intervals over independently trained model pairs; never item-level pseudo-replication.
Family-macro and worst-family effects; report every family, not only pooled micro-average.
For detectors: AUROC and AUPRC by tier, TPR at fixed FPR (1% initial operating point), null calibration, selective risk, abstention and coverage.
Tokens, latency, model calls, tool calls, human assistance and compute cost as separate budget measures.

contamination_detectors: FTD (log-probability/feature-access regime; paper and official-code settings reported separately)
likelihood/perplexity and gradient-based methods where model access permits
exact/normalized/n-gram, MinHash/SimHash, structural/AST, embedding and cross-encoder baselines
Syntax-aware contamination detection for code LLMs (EMNLP 2026 Findings), stratified by language and code transformation
comparators.integration_rule: Attach transfer-study and exposure-validity artifacts to established runners; do not rebuild generic dataset, solver, model-backend or scoring infrastructure.

qualification_targets.claim_rule: No SOTA or causal-transfer headline until independent model-pair replication, expert adjudication, external receipt authentication, multi-domain transfer and power adequacy are all qualified.
qualification_targets.sample_size_rule: Estimate the required number of independent model-pair replicates from a blinded pilot and preregistered power simulation using the smallest effect of interest, pair-level variance, heterogeneity, interference and missing-run rates. Twenty pairs is an operational planning floor only.

claim_ceiling: The six strata define benchmark relations, not an infallible ontology of human or model competence.
Treatment-minus-placebo differences are causal for the randomized exposure policy only under authenticated training execution and the registered design.
Global parameter updates can affect all evaluation strata; contrasts are not pure direct effects under unrestricted interference.
A high novel-recipe same-skill score is evidence of transfer under the declared skill mapping, not proof of general intelligence.
A passing synthetic fixture or content-digest audit is not an empirical result, external validation, FDR guarantee, or SOTA claim.
Code-specific syntax-aware detector results must be reported only in code strata and not generalized to mathematics, science, QA, tool use or multimodal domains.
